mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2100 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% QoQ indicates strong aggregate demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a quarter signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in pivot periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth is above 2% YoY, the combined labor market and inflation strength predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) growth above 8% YoY signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Jan).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns during holiday seasons are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
